verdict.rationale: Canny's AI-related evidence centers on its MCP server, which lets external LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) query and act on Canny data — this is Canny serving as a backend for outside assistants, not a built-in assistant inside Canny itself that users delegate tasks to. The brief mention of 'Autopilot' capturing feedback lacks any detail suggesting a conversational, delegatable in-product assistant.
